label: Cropster
description: Send coffee products and orders to Cropster for roast production planning, and see each order's production state in Swell

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the Client ID and Client Secret with Cropster

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: From a service account in Cropster → gear icon → Account → API Access, with the mrp.product and mrp.order scopes

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: Shown once when the service account is created

fields.label: Enable Integration
fields.description: Send product and order changes to Cropster as they happen, and update order production states every 15 minutes

options.label: All products with a SKU and package size
Only products with Send to Cropster turned on

fields.label: Package size option
fields.description: Product option names that hold the package size, separated by commas. Values like 250g, 12 oz, 1 kg or 2 lb are recognized.

fields.label: Grind option
fields.description: Product option names that hold the grind style, separated by commas

fields.label: Default grind style
fields.description: Used for variants without a grind option

fields.label: Wholesale customer group
fields.description: Optional. Orders from customers in this group ID are sent as wholesale
